decisions.recommendation: UUIDv4 canonical lower-case generated server-side; immutable per occurrence.
instance_id globally unique within a match across players, zones and materialized transient occurrences; exactly one zone reference.
Multiple instances may share card_id; keep the current 12 distinct card_id deck-builder rule unchanged.
exemplar_id is the current global PK cartas_exemplares.id; validate owner/user_id and card_id; do not infer or reuse.
Materialized tokens get instance_id; equipped relic stays outside zones; represent activation as event where possible, otherwise as transient CardInstance with null exemplar_id.
Use target_instance_id; legacy target_id/card_id adapter only when exactly one eligible occurrence matches.
Persisted zone order defines explicit first/last semantics; metric ties use a declared effect tie_breaker, defaulting to zone_order then instance_id.
All removal, return and discard extraction resolve and move exactly one physical occurrence by instance_id.
